verdict.rationale: Puzzle's own help docs say you can export a full general ledger and financial statements, on cash or accrual basis, in Excel, CSV, and PDF. That covers the core accounting record in open formats. The evidence does not show a complete export of all account data, so the 'all of my data' part of the story is unproven. Missing for 10: export of non-ledger data (invoices, attachments, categorization rules, classes, chart of accounts) in open formats, a documented complete account/offboarding export, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: Yes, you can export a full general ledger and financial statements on either cash or accrual basis in excel, csv, and pdf formats.
